text:
alex: quick q — thinking about adding a "rehearsal" flow in the console: a one-click simulate that runs a staged config through shadow routing & quota checks so owners can see cost/latency/regression signals before flipping a flag. thoughts?
priya: love the idea. we need clear UX: show expected token burn delta, latency P95, and a confidence band. also a CTA to pin safety thresholds. :thumbsup:
marco: how do you imagine the traffic? synthetic vs sampled live traffic? sampling is cheaper but can miss spikes.
nina: we should reuse existing shadow-routing infra but add a "rehearsal mode" that attaches extra telemetry labels. that way we get realistic traces without impacting live responses.
andrew: main ops concern: rehearsal must not have side effects (no billing changes, no quota consumption for customer quotas). we need a cost-estimate model that uses our token-cost calc instead of actually charging.
jin: agree. propose an API endpoint + console action: POST /v1/configs/rehearsals with {config_id, scope, sample_rate, dry_run:true} and we return a rehearsal_id and a small report. e.g.:
```
POST /v1/configs/rehearsals
{ "config_id": "cfg-2026-abc", "scope": "route:chat-prod", "sample_rate": 0.05 }
```
sam: we also need safety gates: auto-pause if error-rate delta > X or token delta > Y. make thresholds configurable per-team.
devops-bot: rehearsal-created config_rehearsal=cfg-2026-abc preview=1750202021
emma: UI note: show a diff view (what changes) + timeline with expected resource curve. include links to per-route quota and which dedicated pools would be impacted.
priya: telemetry must include quality signals (model divergence/regression) tied to our eval sets. otherwise people will ignore perf-only metrics and later see hallucination regressions in prod.
marco: what about backcompat? older runtime clients might not send new header for rehearsal. we should run server-side rehearsals (console-triggered) and avoid client-side changes for now.
jin: also provide an SDK helper for customers who want to run local rehearsals against a sandbox. but default path is server-side shadowing.
andrew: ops wants an abort API + webhook when rehearsal breaches gates so automation can roll back config promotion attempts.
alex: agreed. add admin audit entries for every rehearsal run — link to commit/PR and the rehearsal_id. searchable in console.
sam: one more: reserve a small, configurable budget for rehearsals per-org to prevent rehearsal storms from affecting our production telemetry. We can show budget usage in console.
ops-bot: note — need to coordinate with quota team for reservation changes. created ticket ENG-REH-57.
priya: UI: include a "promote" button that runs a final fast-check (0.5% live sampling) and gives an estimated rollout duration and rollback preview before commit.
emma: and show a checklist: audit log present, safety gates set, telemetry baseline captured. otherwise grey out promote.
marco: implementation: plan to reuse sampling & shadow routing + add rehearsal-aggregation pipeline that computes P50/95 token delta, error delta, and eval-scoring delta. store reports for 30d.
jin: storage cost OK if we downsample signals. store full traces only for flagged regressions.
devops-bot: rehearsal-1750202020 completed -> report available at /console/configs/cfg-2026-abc/rehearsals/1750202021 (stub).
sam: can we add an automatic canary that slowly increases sample_rate if gates pass (0.05 -> 0.25 -> 1.0)? controlled by a rollout policy with quiescent windows.
andrew: yes but require explicit opt-in on promote. default is manual step-up.
alex: I'll draft a short RFC with endpoints, console mockups, telemetry schema, and gate definitions. ping @priya @marco @nina to review.
priya: add me pls. happy to help on UX and gate wording.
marco: happy to take the infra part. I'll add perf budget calc prototypes.
nina: i'll sketch telemetry label changes and eval hook mapping.
alex: sweet — thanks all, filing RFC now.
ops-bot: FYI — if anyone wants to run an immediate rehearsal w/ a sandbox token, DM ops to get temp quota.
